R1.description: A pure selection walks a role's chain in order and chooses the first entry whose launcher resolves and whose provider the usage gate admits; a hold skips every later entry of the held provider without a second admission; an unavailable launcher is skipped (H9b)

R2.description: When no entry can be launched the outcome is today's: the earliest waitable hold (else the first hold) is returned to the existing wait path, or the first entry's HarnessRoleError is raised when none was held (H9b)

R3.description: The worker launch selects only when the role has a chain, before the record exists and never after; a role without a chain takes the existing lines and writes a byte-identical record; the chosen entry satisfies the family rules by construction (H9b)

R4.description: The job record gains the optional worker_route.selection block (position, length, skipped causes) and telemetry the chain_position and chain_skipped dimensions, additive only; telemetry reads the harness from the record (H9b)

R5.description: The guides and the roadmap describe the selection, its narrow definition and the limit of the present detection, shipped as a feat change (H9b)
